label: input q early in the original sequence (steps 1-3)
explanation: Fires mostly in the original phase (85% of activation mass) at steps 1-3, and most strongly when the input is q (58% of mass, 14.7x lift). Weaker triggers are y, g, l and 3. Largest activations come when q follows an earlier q or 3 at the start of the sequence (e.g. q q q, 3 q q, 3 3 q), so magnitude depends on prefix history. Only about 45% of early q inputs make it fire, depending on what came before in a way that no simple rule captures. There is a smaller copy-phase component (15% of mass) at late recall positions, often when the input is y. Never fires at t=0 and almost never at the delimiter. Best simple predicate: dev F1 about 0.41, mass recall 0.53.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by phase (input phase: q, g, l, 3; copy phase: y, 0, f, x; delimiter step: ) and the previous input (most: q, 3, g, p, l, o; least: y, h, -, 0); timing cues that raise it most: t=2, t=1, L=3 & t=3.
